objective: Take up BARE-NAMES-20261110-001's direction 1 at the coordinator's go-ahead of 2026-11-10: the challenge of A59. Under abstract names a renaming of finitely many names is a finite change, so the source-aware condition excludes nothing. Count changes up to renaming instead, with the definition frozen before any run: a value is flipped in place by a minimal change of values alone, the board kept, that is not a renaming; a neighbour distinction by a minimal change of neighbour distinctions alone, the values kept, that is not a renaming. Ticket A proves when changes are renamings (finite-component worlds and tree worlds), that the switch flips neighbour distinctions in place, that transplants make a count excluding only renamings cheap again, and that some laws cascade. Ticket B marks the 90 board-value knots of BARE-NAMES-20261110-001B in finite-component and tree worlds. No change to the canonical knot test is proposed; a result that bears on it goes to the owner as a question.
stop_rule: One epic: the census runs once on the frozen family and worlds; the lemmas are each proved, refuted or left with the gap stated; A59's status is set by the frozen rule. No change to the canonical knot test; anything that bears on it is reported to the owner as a question and the epic stops there.
title: Nativeness up to renaming
